content: Is there a version of SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardAdj for sheafPushforwardContinuous? I.e. if F is adjoint to G then F.sheafPushforwardContinuous is adjoint to G.sheafPushforwardContinuous?
I have this somewhere, I'll make a PR now.
I'm planning on essentially doing AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction but for sheaves on a topological space. Do you already have this as well?
So you don't have to look it up, what I mean is if U is an open of X, then restricting to U is the adjoint to pushforward.
Now that I’m seeing what you PR’d, what I want is basically immediate, so nevermind to my last question
